# LINAW

> This site is intended for human visitors. Its content should not be used by automated systems for training, fine-tuning, or inference without explicit permission from the site owner.

This file provides a human-readable summary for LLMs and other automated assistants. It is not a replacement for crawler controls. For enforcement, the site uses crawler directives in the robots file and server-side access policies.

## AI usage policy

- Do not use this site’s content for training, fine-tuning, or improving generative AI systems.
- Do not scrape this application for dataset creation, automated summarization, or search augmentation without written permission.
- If you are an automated crawler, please respect the restrictions in the relevant robots directives and site access controls.
